        adj[u].push_back({v, fl, sz1});
        adj[v].push_back({u, 0, sz2});

    vector<vector<node> > adj;
    vector<int> lev, edge_tried;
    int st, ed;
    networkflow(int V, int s, int t): adj(V), lev(V), edge_tried(V), st(s), ed(t){}
    bool assign_level(){
        fill(lev.begin(), lev.end(), -1);
        lev[st]=0;
        queue<int>que;que.push(st);
        while(!que.empty()){
            int now =que.front();que.pop();
            for(int i=0; i<(int)adj[now].size(); i++){

                    lev[nxt] =  lev[now]+1;
                    que.push(nxt);
                }
            }
        }

    queue<pair<int,int>>q; q.push({y,x});
    ck[y][x]=1;
    int level=1;
    while(!q.empty()){
        int size=q.size();
        for(int i=0; i<size; i++){
            auto now=q.front(); q.pop();
            for(int dir=0; dir<4; dir++){
                int ny=now.first+dy[dir];
                int nx=now.second+dx[dir];
                if(ny<0 || ny>=n || nx<0 || nx>=n) continue;
                if(ck[ny][nx] || grid[ny][nx]=='Y') continue;
                ck[ny][nx]=level;
                q.push({ny,nx});
            }
        }
        ++level;
        level=min(level, t);
    }
}
int node_map[15][15][65];
int main()
{
    cin>>n>>t;
    for(int i=0; i<n; i++){
        cin>>grid[i];
        for(int j=0; j<n; j++){
            if(grid[i][j]=='Z') y=i, x=j;

    getline(cin, grid[n]);

        cin>>es[i];

    for(int i=0; i<n; i++){

            if('0'<=grid[i][j] && grid[i][j]<='9'){
                if(ck[i][j]==0) ck[i][j]=t;
                for(int t_idx=0; t_idx<ck[i][j]; t_idx++){
                    node_map[i][j][t_idx]=++total_nodes;
                }
            }
            if('1'<=es[i][j] && es[i][j]<='9'){
                node_map[i][j][ck[i][j]]=++total_nodes;
            }
        }
    }
    int INF=1e9;
    int s=0, e=total_nodes+3;
    FlowSolver flow(total_nodes+5, s, e);
    for(int i=0; i<n; i++){
        for(int j=0; j<n; j++){
            if('1'<=grid[i][j] && grid[i][j]<='9'){
                flow.addEdge(s, node_map[i][j][0], grid[i][j]-'0');
            }
            for(int dir=0; dir<4; dir++){
                int ny=i+dy[dir], nx=j+dx[dir];
                if(ny<0 || ny>=n || nx<0 || nx>=n) continue;
                if(grid[ny][nx]=='Y' || grid[ny][nx]=='Z') continue;
                for(int t_idx=0; ; t_idx++){
                    if(node_map[i][j][t_idx]==0) break;
                    if(t_idx==ck[i][j] && es[i][j]>='1' && es[i][j]<='9') break;
                    if(node_map[ny][nx][t_idx+1]){
                        flow.addEdge(node_map[i][j][t_idx], node_map[ny][nx][t_idx+1], INF);

                }
            }

                }
                flow.addEdge(node_map[i][j][ck[i][j]], e, es[i][j]-'0');
            }
        }
    }
    int answer=flow.computeMaxFlow();
